svg.title: Preserve expert information and student preferences

cc:Work.dc:title: Preserve expert information and student preferences
cc:Work.dc:description: Illustration, not measured results. Student and expert response distributions differ. Shading marks responses that meet expert requirements, such as preserving the required answer, reasoning steps or other information. New training data preserves the student relative preferences within that set.
